reason: Adds a Windows-only DSH permission mode that restores sandbox HTTPS access through a bundled OpenSSL curl while retaining workspace-write file protections; human review is appropriate because it changes sandbox network permissions and patches the engine.

summaries.zh: 为 Windows 版 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Net Access 权限模式，在保留 workspace-write 文件写保护的同时通过内置 OpenSSL curl 恢复沙箱内的 HTTPS 访问。
summaries.en: Adds a Windows-only Net Access mode to DeepSeek Harness that restores HTTPS access inside the sandbox through a bundled OpenSSL curl while retaining workspace-write file protections.

capabilities: Adds a Net Access permission mode to a Windows sandbox
Enables HTTPS requests through a bundled OpenSSL-based curl executable
Patches the DSH engine and registers a permission preset
Downloads curl tools from curl.se during setup
